The crystal teleport seed has 3 right-click destinations that can be unlocked after the appropriate quests have been completed (see below). The Prifddinas option opens a dialogue box that allows the player to teleport to any of the city's eight elven clan districts.
To unlock the Temple of Light option, players must speak to Eluned in Isafdar (not via the NPC contact spell, nor in the Prifddinas location). This will only work when carrying one seed; carrying multiple seeds will prevent the teleport from being added.
Alternatively, if the player has completed The Light Within, Eluned is replaced with Islwyn. Players need to speak to Islwyn at the Ithell Clan district in Prifddinas near the singing bowl instead. Here, he will speak to the player about chanting the crystal with new teleports.
To unlock the Prifddinas option, players must walk onto the bridge to Prifddinas for the first time to trigger a skippable cutscene, after which the option is unlocked automatically.
When an attuned crystal teleport seed is shared via the Group Ironman Storage, it will only teleport the player to Lletya if no related quests have been completed.
